university: Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin

documents.notes: 'Direct Application Information'. The application dates shown on the page are for the 2026 cycle (1 November 2025 - 30 June 2026); the document list itself states no year. Not drafted: application fee payment form (no vocabulary kind).

items.quote: Applicants who are not resident in the EU, EEA, UK countries or Switzerland are usually defined as non-EU/international applicants and apply directly to Trinity via the page of the course they wish to study.
As part of the online application, applicants will also need to submit original or certified true * copies of: Final second level qualification results
IELTS, Cambridge Advanced/Proficiency, TOEFL scores, for applicants whose first language is not English
items.condition: your first language is not English

items.quote: SAT, AP or ACT scores (US and Canadian applicants only)

Completing an Application In your application you will see these steps: Your Details Contact Details English Language Proficiency Education Experience Personal Statement References Additional Documentation Terms and conditions & Declaration Any fields that are mandatory are marked with an asterisk.
items.notes: The step's prompt, shown separately on the page: 'Please explain why you have chosen to study at Trinity College Dublin, what you hope to gain academically from the courses you chose, and what you can contribute to Trinity during your stay here.'

items.quote: where the statement of examination results is in a language other than English, applicants should submit a certified true translation of the statement along with a certified true copy of their original results with the application.
